texts.label: Mary Queen of Scots to Norfolk, 'the 20th' [Feb or Mar 1570], BL Cotton MS Caligula C II f. 74r
texts.summary: Written after Moray's murder at Linlithgow (23 Jan 1570): Mary tells Norfolk she will undertake nothing unless it is safe for them both, urges him to write to the Bishop of Ross and to act through his sister Scrope or others, says Elizabeth blames her for Moray's death, reports rumours of Morton and Lord Talbot, and begs him not to risk writing in his own hand. No sign-level transcription of the cipher exists; the reading was made on the image strips.
texts.note: Mary's Scots-English reads in places, but lines 1, 4-6, 8-10 and 12-17 carry [..] holes, a stain or unkeyed nomenclator signs, so about half the sentences do not build (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026); fix: re-read those lines on the line strips (view/Lnn*.jpg, from the BL IIIF images) and settle the six unkeyed signs from the sibling letters ff. 66, 69, 75, then write a running text with a modern English version.

outcome.fraction_read_source: Reading audit, 22 Oct 2026: f. 74r, the only document, is decoded, not read, so no tokens are in a document that reads. The field was "unknown" before.
